name: Tamayura no Dinette
original_name: たまゆらのディネット
source: Kagaya wakes up in an unfamilar atelier, having no memory of who he is, and with a leash attached to his neck held by a strange man dressed in lolita garb. The man, Dinette, introduces himself as the owner of the place, and of Kagaya as well, claiming that Kagaya is his beloved "doll" that he hides from the world to protect him.
translation: 加贺屋在一个陌生的工作室中醒来，不记得自己是谁，脖子上拴着一条皮带，被一个穿着洛丽塔服装的陌生男子抓住。这个名叫迪内特的男人介绍自己是这个地方的主人，也是加贺屋的主人，声称加贺屋是他心爱的“娃娃”，他为了保护他而隐藏起来。
